study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Jalbrzikowski et al., American Journal of Psychiatry, 2019
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Age-Associated Deviations of Amygdala Functional Connectivity in Youths With Psychosis Spectrum Disorders: Relevance to Psychotic Symptoms

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study utilizes data from the Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC) and three additional cohorts from the University of Pittsburgh (Luna 1, Luna 2, and a Pittsburgh Neurodevelopmental Cohort).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Resting-state functional neuroimaging data from four samples (three cross-sectional, one longitudinal) were collected for 1,062 participants... Three data sets were acquired at the University of Pittsburgh and one at the University of Pennsylvania (28, 29).

answer.PNC: normative training/testing (HC) and patient for clinical research (PS, OP)

answer.MULTI-SITE (N>=2): normative training/testing (HC) and patient for clinical research (PS)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: HC participants from all cohorts (N=622) were used to construct the normative template (growth charts). Psychosis spectrum (PS) and other psychopathology (OP) participants were used to assess deviations.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: ...construct a normative template of age-related changes to be used as a growth chart... assess how psychiatric disorders are related to deviations from normative development... typically developing control subjects, N=622; individuals with psychosis spectrum disorders, N=194; individuals with other psychopathology, N=246
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Jalbrzikowski2019.pdf.md: Abstract / Objective and Methods; Methods / Participants

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: 622 typically developing control youths were used to define the normative trajectories for both amygdala subregions. The paper does not explicitly describe a separate training/testing split within the HC group for model construction.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: ...622 typically developing control youths... We used the 3dLME program in AFNI to examine voxelwise developmental effects of age for each amygdala subregion in typically developing control youths.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Jalbrzikowski2019.pdf.md: Abstract / Methods; Methods / Statistical Analyses

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The weighted mean and pooled SD were calculated using the demographic information provided for each of the four HC cohorts in Table 1. The age range is explicitly stated as 10-25 years.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: The final neuroimaging data set consisted of 1,062 participants 10 -25 years old (typically developing control subjects, N=622...)

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Sex distribution was calculated by summing the male and female counts for the HC groups across the four cohorts listed in Table 1.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: Luna 1: 113/100; Luna 2: 45/43; Philadelphia: 151/141; Neurodevelopmental Cohort Pitt: 18/11
